proof:
by
  intro v0 v1 h
  simp only [pre, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
  have key : ∀ (l : List Int), List.Pairwise (fun (a b : Int) => a ≤ b) l →
      (∀ x ∈ l.take (List.findIdx (fun y => decide (v1 ≤ y)) l), x < v1) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ l.drop (List.findIdx (fun y => decide (v1 ≤ y)) l), v1 ≤ x) := by
    intro l
    induction l with
    | nil => intro _; simp
    | cons a t ih =>
      intro hl
      rw [List.pairwise_cons] at hl
      have ht := ih hl.2
      by_cases hav : v1 ≤ a
      · have hb : List.findIdx (fun y => decide (v1 ≤ y)) (a :: t) = 0 := by
          simp [List.findIdx_cons, hav]
        rw [hb, List.take_zero, List.drop_zero]
        refine ⟨by simp, ?_⟩
        intro x hx
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx with hx1 | hx2
        · subst hx1; omega
        · have hb2 := hl.1 x hx2; omega
      · have hb : List.findIdx (fun y => decide (v1 ≤ y)) (a :: t)
            = List.findIdx (fun y => decide (v1 ≤ y)) t + 1 := by
          simp [List.findIdx_cons, hav]
        rw [hb, List.take_succ_cons, List.drop_succ_cons]
        refine ⟨?_, ht.2⟩
        intro x hx
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx with hx1 | hx2
        · subst hx1; omega
        · exact ht.1 x hx2
  have hn : List.findIdx (fun x => decide (v1 ≤ x)) v0 ≤ v0.length := by
    first
      | exact List.findIdx_le_length _ _
      | exact List.findIdx_le_length
      | simp [List.findIdx_le_length]
  have hs1 := pythonSlice_prefix v0 (List.findIdx (fun x => decide (v1 ≤ x)) v0) hn
  have hs2 := pythonSlice_suffix v0 (List.findIdx (fun x => decide (v1 ≤ x)) v0) hn
  simp only [post, implementation, hs1, hs2, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq,
    List.all_eq_true]
  refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · first
      | omega
      | (simp only [Int.ofNat_eq_natCast] at *; omega)
      | simp
  · first
      | (simp only [Int.ofNat_eq_natCast] at *; omega)
      | omega
      | simp_all
  · intro x hx
    have hk := (key v0 h).1 x hx
    first
      | omega
      | exact hk
      | (simp only [decide_eq_true_eq]; omega)
      | simp_all
  · intro x hx
    have hk := (key v0 h).2 x hx
    first
      | omega
      | exact hk
      | (simp only [decide_eq_true_eq]; omega)
      | simp_all
